The '''Pyrewood Tailor''' is a [[human]] [[cloth]] [[armor]] [[vendor]] found at the [[Pyrewood Village]] of [[Silverpine Forest]]. At night, he transforms into his [[worgen]] form as '''[[Moonrage Tailor]]'''. He can be seen wandering from his house behind the [[Blacksmith (building)|smithy]] and out in the street in front of the smith and back.

==Notes==
*He is affiliated with [[Stormwind (faction)|Stormwind]] during the daytime to make him unattackable by Alliance players.
